turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's grade is why I'm here. What happened to his essay?
Thanks isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Flattery isn't evidence, Hale. What do you have on this essay?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
I'm not here to be liked. Is there a document, yes or no?
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
Your way being what? Say it, or show me what you're basing it on.
